recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the FHIR-50705 reconciliation without changing already-correct differentials, and future work should not restore observation-vitalsign-category or put vital-sign-specific LOINC identifiers in Observation.category. Any unrelated Vital Signs summary cleanup should be tracked separately.
issue_request: FHIR-50705 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request warning that the R6 Vital Signs profiles appeared to move specific LOINC semantics from Observation.code to Observation.category, creating a breaking and unsafe change. Its resolution points to the FHIR-45617/FHIR-50689 decision family and treats the requested outcome as pre-applied: do not identify specific vital signs by category.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-50705. The applicable history is the category-vs-code issue family: 0a17c0f40f introduced the temporary category value-set/binding approach, and 66a80b5fef moved the interoperability standard LOINC identifiers back from Observation.category to Observation.code and removed observation-vitalsign-category. The formal differentials were mostly correct, but active summary extensions and two examples still carried the stale category model.
additional_context: FHIR-50689 and FHIR-49953 make the same revert/backward-compatibility argument; FHIR-50392 rejects using category for specific vital-sign searches. 2025-10-30 OO minutes record FHIR-50705 as Persuasive/Pre-applied, and the Zulip thread that led to duplicate FHIR-54960 independently confirms the Text Summary metadata was missed when the code moved back to Observation.code. source/fhir.ini and the Vital Signs implementation guide show the edited Observation/Vital Signs files are active build inputs.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that updates the structuredefinition-summary/profile-summary metadata for the specific Vital Signs profiles to say Observation.code and Observation.code.coding for the LOINC identifiers, removes LOINC-coded Observation.category blocks from the Body Weight and BMI examples, and updates stale category wording in the Observation ballot note and example comments.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalspanel.xml and peer specific Vital Signs profile XML files: changed summary/profile-summary metadata from Observation.category to Observation.code for profile-specific LOINC identifiers.

source/observation/observation-example.xml and source/observation/observation-example-bmi-using-related.xml: removed stale LOINC-coded Observation.category blocks, leaving the LOINC identifiers in Observation.code.

source/observation/observation-introduction.xml, source/observation/observation-example-body-length.xml, and source/observation/observation-example-f202-temperature.xml: updated stale interoperability-category wording to the current interoperability-standard/code model.
